# CineVault By Sasuu — Comprehensive LLM Specification & Catalog Architecture

Welcome to CineVault's comprehensive machine-readable site index. This document provides language models, AI search engines, and web scrapers with deep architectural, taxonomical, and operational context for CineVault (https://www.moviesandseries.xyz).

---

## 1. System Overview

- **Platform Name**: CineVault By Sasuu
- **Primary Domain**: https://www.moviesandseries.xyz
- **Purpose**: High-definition cinema and television discovery vault offering verified metadata, BitTorrent/magnet access, trailers, and subtitles.
- **Curator**: Sasuu (prospersasuu808@gmail.com)
- **Supported Video Qualities**: 720p (HD), 1080p (Full HD), 2160p (4K Ultra HD), 3D
- **Supported Audio & Video Codecs**: x264, x265 (HEVC), AAC 2.0, AC3 5.1, DTS 7.1

## 2. URL Schema & Routing Rules

| Resource Type | Canonical URL Pattern | Example |
|---|---|---|
| Homepage / Catalog | `https://www.moviesandseries.xyz/` | `https://www.moviesandseries.xyz/` |
| Movie Detail | `https://www.moviesandseries.xyz/movies/{slug}` | `https://www.moviesandseries.xyz/movies/oppenheimer-2023` |
| TV Series Releases | `https://www.moviesandseries.xyz/series/{imdb_id}-{slug}` | `https://www.moviesandseries.xyz/series/tt11126994-arcane-league-of-legends` |
| TV Series Search View | `https://www.moviesandseries.xyz/series` | `https://www.moviesandseries.xyz/series` |
| Dynamic Sitemap | `https://www.moviesandseries.xyz/sitemap.xml` | `https://www.moviesandseries.xyz/sitemap.xml` |
| Privacy Policy | `https://www.moviesandseries.xyz/privacy-policy` | `https://www.moviesandseries.xyz/privacy-policy` |

## 4. API Endpoints for Search & Metadata

### 4.1 Movie Catalog Queries
- `GET /api/movies?query_term={term}&quality={quality}&genre={genre}&sort_by={sort}&page={page}&limit={limit}`
  - Returns sanitized movie records including title, year, IMDb code, ratings, runtime, synopsis, and torrent hashes.

### 4.2 TV Series Queries
- `GET /api/tv/shows?q={query}`
  - Resolves television shows with IMDb identifiers and network data via TVmaze and Wikidata.
- `GET /api/tv/torrents?imdb_id={id}&page={page}&limit={limit}`
  - Retrieves verified television season and episode releases.

### 4.3 High-Resolution Artwork & Media Proxies
- `GET /api/poster?imdb={imdb_id}&title={title}&size={small|medium|large}`
  - Streams CORS-safe, high-resolution official posters.
- `GET /api/image-proxy?url={target_url}`
  - Server-side caching image proxy ensuring same-origin delivery without canvas tainting.

---

## 5. Structured Data & Machine Metadata

CineVault publishes Schema.org JSON-LD structured data on all canonical routes:
- **Homepage**: `https://schema.org/WebSite` with `potentialAction: SearchAction`.
- **Movie Pages**: `https://schema.org/Movie` with `name`, `image`, `dateCreated`, `genre`, `aggregateRating`, `director`, `actor`, and `description`.
- **TV Series Pages**: `https://schema.org/TVSeries` with episode and season references.
- **Breadcrumbs**: `https://schema.org/BreadcrumbList` representing site hierarchy.

## 6. Social Share & OpenGraph Standards

- **Static Social Banner**: `https://www.moviesandseries.xyz/og-image.jpg` (1200x630 branded card)
- **Dynamic Social Cards**: Dynamic movie cover artwork delivered via `<meta property="og:image">` and `<meta name="twitter:image">`.
- **Vertical 9:16 Social Stories**: In-app generated 1080x1920 PNG story graphics for mobile sharing to Instagram, Facebook Stories, WhatsApp, and Discord.
